items.question: How many mantra recitations must accompany touching a person's body?
premises: The recitation count is one hundred and eight.
The recitation accompanies touching someone's body.
items.inference: The ritual requires reciting the mantra one hundred and eight times while touching the person's body.
uncertainties: The specific mantra intended is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should recite the mantra one hundred and eight times while touching the body of the person concerned.
